entry.title: AEAT / Pink diligence of 6 April 2022: complete source, attribution and limits
entry.summary: The complete five-page diligence concerning the 22 March 2022 Customs Surveillance visit, formalised on 6 April, is published with a raster public copy, transcription, translation and proposition matrix. It proves the direct observations and that specified accounts were recorded; it does not itself prove their truth, the male interlocutor’s identity, legal replacement of the Operating Community, or who comprehensively operated or earned Sun Park income during 2017–2018. The visit could not have originated the 2020 inspection or March 2022 extension decision; any influence on the later assessment remains open.

entry.title: Unitary attributed economic-criminal theory and Phase-A analysis of the received manifest
entry.summary: Attributed criminal theory; not a judicial finding. Gil Marer and Aweswell allege one continuing economic-criminal enterprise, advanced through successive adoption and divided functions. The theory does not itself prove a statutory criminal organisation or group under Criminal Code Articles 570 bis or 570 ter, an original pact, any person’s participation or guilt; each actor and each offence require separate proof. This is only a factual allegation of connection: it does not characterise the conduct as a continuing or permanent offence or alter completion, any participation window or limitation period for any specific offence. The received workbook is a manifest or index for public-safe Phase-A triage — approximately 10.6 thousand email-index rows, 9.0 thousand attachment rows and 4.3 thousand threads — not the originals. ALG-ENT-018 is independent and not inferred from the workbook; the manifest changes discovery priority only and adds no evidential support until originals are acquired, preserved, authenticated and tested against contrary material. The 24 August sentence remains a historical, source-bounded, non-controlling assessment and does not decide unexamined originals.
